intro: Poetry: identity and belonging: the big ideas, key words and examples on one sheet. Keep it in your book and use it to revise (cover, write, check).

panels.title: Big questions
points: What do these four poems say together about people?

keywords.def: a big idea a text explores
what the writer wants readers to think or do
a technique a writer uses, such as a metaphor or a refrain

panels.title: Whole-unit retrieval and poetry masterclass
points: retrieve a key quotation and method for each poem
link two poems through a shared idea
plan a PETZAAL answer on one poem in five minutes

panels.title: How does Hughes present resilience?
points: Point 1: the staircase as a hard life ('no crystal stair')
Point 2: still climbing (landings, corners, the dark)
Point 3: the command 'don't you turn back'
Alternative: love as much as strictness
Answer: A five-line plan: three points with quotations, an Alternative and a Link.
